challenges: Escalating Per-Video Spectacle Costs ($2M-$4.5M/Episode) vs. Media Standalone Margin: Controlling massive set-build, contestant, VFX, and multi-hundred-camera ingest costs so media operations generate positive free cash flow rather than relying on Feastables CPG cross-subsidization.

Sustaining >=10% Browse CTR & >=65% AVD Across 350M+ Global Subscribers: Overcoming viewer habituation where yesterday's extreme spectacle becomes tomorrow's baseline expectation, requiring continuous 0-30s hook and story-arc innovation.

Physical Production Safety, Contestant Welfare & Guild/Legal Governance at Reality-TV Scale: Enforcing rigorous Hollywood-grade UPM safety, medical oversight, legal releases, and contest-law compliance across 1,000-person stunt shoots (e.g., Beast Games).

Multi-Petabyte Multi-Cam Dailies Triage (200-400+ Cameras per Shoot): Automating transcript/visual logging across thousands of hours of raw GoPro, cinema, and lavalier feeds so retention editors find emotional story turns in hours rather than weeks.

20+ Language Global Dubbing & Cultural Packaging Localization: Synchronizing lip-accurate voice dubs, translated on-screen text graphics, and culturally calibrated thumbnails at simultaneous Hour-0 global release.
